quests.dispatcherQuestion: A washing machine hose has burst and is flooding a kitchen. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what must be stopped at the source.
quests.explanation: Shutting the water off at the valve stops the flooding from getting any worse.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has been stung by a wasp and is struggling to breathe. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for trained help to be sent.
quests.explanation: Trouble breathing after a sting can mean a serious allergic reaction that needs urgent treatment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports her handbag was grabbed while she waited for a bus. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say what the officer should do first.
quests.explanation: A prompt report while details are fresh gives police the best chance of recovering her bag.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Steam and smoke are coming from an overheated laptop charger. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say the fastest way to cut its power.
quests.explanation: Unplugging the charger removes its power source before the overheating can turn into a fire.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cyclist has come off his bike on black ice and hit his head. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Formally ask for the ambulance to be sent.
quests.explanation: Any head injury after a fall needs a paramedic assessment, since symptoms can appear later.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A resident reports loud banging and shouting from a locked neighboring flat. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the extra support officers need.
quests.explanation: Officers can check on the residents' safety and calm the situation before anyone is hurt.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A grease fire has flared up on a food truck's grill. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Let the local fire team know right away.
quests.explanation: Grease fires can flare up again suddenly, so a properly equipped crew should handle it.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has fainted while queueing outside in the heat. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say the first thing to do for him.
quests.explanation: Getting him out of direct sun and heat is the first step before any other treatment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A shop's front window has been smashed and the till is missing. Input police code!
quests.hint: Name the service that responds to crime.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can secure the scene and begin gathering evidence while it's still fresh.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has twisted her knee badly coming down a staircase. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what she should do until help arrives.
quests.explanation: Staying still prevents further damage to a knee that may already be seriously injured.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A faulty space heater has set a rug on fire in a dorm room. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the department responsible for fire risks.
quests.explanation: Even a small rug fire can fill a room with smoke fast, so help should be called at once.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver reports being followed and flashed by another car on the motorway. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for a police vehicle already on the road.
quests.explanation: Reporting this while still driving helps police track the other vehicle and check on her safety.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A child has a high fever and a rash that won't fade when pressed. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that carries paramedics to come.
quests.explanation: A rash that doesn't fade under pressure can signal a serious infection needing urgent care.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Wind has ripped a tarpaulin loose and it's blocking a busy road junction. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to protect drivers.
quests.explanation: Closing the junction keeps drivers from swerving suddenly to avoid the loose tarpaulin.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is caught trying to leave a store without paying for goods. Input police code!
quests.hint: Let the police know what you're seeing.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can respond while staff are still able to describe the man and what he took.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has a nail gun injury to his hand on a building site. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Send help trained to treat injuries.
quests.explanation: A nail gun injury needs careful medical removal, so paramedics should handle it, not a first-aider alone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A chip pan has caught fire and flames are reaching the extractor fan. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicles firefighters arrive in, urgently.
quests.explanation: Flames reaching the extractor can spread fire into the wall cavity, so a full crew must respond.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A resident reports a strange man peering into cars in the apartment car park. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send the service that handles this kind of incident.
quests.explanation: Reporting this while he's still there gives police the best chance of catching him in the act.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hiker has rolled her ankle badly on a rocky trail. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what she should do until help arrives.
quests.explanation: Staying still avoids putting weight on an ankle that may be fractured, not just twisted.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A neighbor's barbecue coals have set a wooden fence alight. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Send the official service trained to fight fires.
quests.explanation: A fence fire can reach a house wall within minutes, so a crew should respond quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports someone repeatedly ringing her doorbell and running away at midnight. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send an official police vehicle to the scene.
quests.explanation: A patrol car nearby can check the area and reassure her that someone is looking into it.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has been struck by a falling shop sign on a windy day. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to reach the patient quickly.
quests.explanation: A blow to the head or body from a falling object needs a full paramedic assessment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Strong winds have torn roof tiles loose over a busy footpath. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to protect people below.
quests.explanation: Closing the footpath keeps pedestrians from walking under tiles that could fall at any moment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A parked motorbike has been tipped over and its mirrors smashed deliberately. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say what the officer should do first.
quests.explanation: Even without a theft of the bike itself, a report of the damage is needed for the owner's insurance.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is having a seizure on the floor of a train station. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what bystanders should do first.
quests.explanation: Clearing space around him stops him from hitting nearby objects while the seizure passes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A faulty dryer has started a fire in a laundrette. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: Dryer fires can spread into wall vents, so a properly equipped crew needs to check it fully.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver is swerving between lanes and appears to be asleep at the wheel. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A driver who may be falling asleep is a danger to everyone on the road and needs to be stopped.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has a suspected broken wrist after slipping on ice. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what she should do until help arrives.
quests.explanation: Keeping the wrist still prevents a possible fracture from being made worse before treatment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Lightning has struck a tree in a park, setting the branches alight. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name who should respond, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: A lightning-struck tree can keep burning and drop flaming branches, so a crew should attend.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen tampering with the lock on a neighbor's shed. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: Tampering with a lock is a clear sign of an attempted break-in that police should stop quickly.
